title: Boombox
description: An old cheap tape recorder with a radio.
details: A very basic tape recorder is connected to the computer. You used to use it to store programs on cassette tapes, but now you have a floppy disk drive for that. And yet you store your software archives on tapes. Some Commodore programs can also output sound to it. Everything works fine, but the magnetic head needs to be adjusted frequently with a screwdriver, and the cassette deck needs to be secured with duct tape.
